## Complete negative result, with precise source scope

For problem 30004909 / OWR-8415356-020, this proof-only edition gives a complete obstruction to dimension-independent approximation by one ordinary matroid rank on the same finite ground set.

The square-root-cardinality family f(S)=sqrt(|S|) forces alpha >= n^(1/6). The complete manuscript also proves that uniform matroids attain the exact square-root-family optimum min_R max(sqrt(R),sqrt(n)/R), with sharp n^(1/6) for cube n. A rational-valued family on n=m² elements forces alpha²+alpha >= m and alpha >= n^(1/4)/sqrt(2). All claims use one basis/full-ground-set method, approach 1/5.

## Source correction and limits

[László Végh's original contribution](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46931), Oberwolfach Report 53/2021, printed p. 2946 (PDF page 54), displays r(S)/alpha <= f(S) <= alpha*r(S). The corpus omitted the lower denominator; this proof treats the source-corrected, weaker comparison. The source says constant without separately quantifying over finite ground sets. The edition makes the dimension-independent interpretation explicit.

The result concerns a single ordinary rank on the same ground set. It does not address sums of ranks, weighted ranks, expanded ground sets, a scalar-rescaled output class, or an unspecified alternative intended formulation. The square-root-family sharpness is not an optimal exponent claim for all normalized submodular functions. No novelty, historical-priority, exhaustive-literature or prior-current-open-status claim is made. The related Goemans–Harvey–Iwata–Mirrokni oracle-learning problem has a different output class and is not used to infer this result.

## Complete proof and mathematical/source audit

REPORT.md is preserved byte-for-byte, including every proof, qualification and source reference. SOURCE_AUDIT.md retains all mathematical checks, original-source observations, literature-search limits and disposition. Only private repository/corpus-history and deduplication details are omitted; the public audit explicitly labels this editorial selection. The selected artifact inventory binds the actual edition documents and omits supplementary computational/private-history identities. A separate complete reading accepted the same mathematical scope.

The written proof is self-contained. AI-assisted mathematical/source acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant verification. The bounded literature search did not locate an exact prior presentation of this elementary obstruction; it does not certify novelty.

## Exact additive boundary

Add exactly nine files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004909/`. No QUEUE.md or unrelated repository file changes. No executable scripts, fixtures, standalone computational outputs, logs, copied third-party documents, source text, source renderings, datasets, private sources or coordination files are included, and no hashes of those excluded materials are published. Raw public PDF identities and source inspection history are metadata only. Byte checks and clean additive replay establish packaging integrity, not mathematical truth. Draft for review; no merge or release is requested.
